gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-kiwi-mar: Expressive and bold, with ascenders that barely clear the x-height. Love Ya Like A Sister sets the tone, while Kiwi Maru's generous letterspacing and ringlike o lets longer paragraphs drift along unhurried.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-padyakke: Padyakke Expanded One spreads its glyphs like knots on a slack rope, authoritative and wide. Padyakke Expanded One carries the literary weight, while Love Ya Like A Sister is the one for bold, expressive swagger.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-stint-ul: Loud and low-slung: Love Ya Like A Sister is expressive, bold, and level, with outward-pointing terminal tips. Stint Ultra Expanded, a text serif, lets every character float apart over paragraphs.
gen-gf-loved-by-the-king-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans is sharp and refined, with generous space where curves meet the stem. Bespoke Sans suits quick glances beneath Loved by the King, whose hand-drawn, tightly packed letters feel personal and relaxed.
gen-gf-loved-by-the-king-fs-literata: Loved by the King writes in a relaxed, personal hand, with wide s curves and compressed spacing. And Literata, the sophisticated serif, does the bookish detail, though it won't carry endless paragraphs.
gen-gf-lugrasimo-fs-amulya: Amulya is a crisp, modern sans whose curves leave generous gaps. Amulya sits beneath Lugrasimo, friendly, loose, and hand-drawn, and feels pleasant when taken a little at a time.
gen-gf-lugrasimo-fs-chillax: Lugrasimo has a loose, hand-drawn friendliness, with a spread-out line and no ink pooling at the turns. Chillax brings casual punch in bold, spaghetti-like strokes that never thicken or thin, good for a brief line.
gen-gf-lugrasimo-fs-gambetta: A hand-drawn looseness leads, spread out and friendly in Lugrasimo. Gambetta, a bookish classic serif with wide channels into every counter, brings the grace, though brief bursts suit it better than pages.
gen-gf-lugrasimo-fs-plein: Lugrasimo writes with mild stroke contrast and a loose, spread-out, hand-drawn line that feels friendly and inviting. Plein, reliable and clean, makes a sturdy partner for a couple of lines.
gen-gf-lugrasimo-fs-roundo: Friendly and inviting, Lugrasimo draws a loose, hand-drawn line, with crossbars a touch finer than its main stems. Lugrasimo supplies the charm; Roundo stays geometric and uncluttered for light reading.
